### Out From the Ark
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/out-ark
Passage: Genesis 8:13-17
Points:
- Noah's preservation and exit from the ark display God's unmerited, saving grace.
- Human deliverance depends on divine mercy rather than moral perfection or self-effort.
- God faithfully preserves a remnant to uphold His covenant promises and glory.
- Believers are reminded to praise the Lord whose initiative alone rescues from judgment.
